Trim US tech longs and add ID tech leaders on pullbacks, targeting 10-15% upside over 60 days.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's renewable build-out is accelerating on new presidential mandates for solar and geothermal, creating durable demand for local EPC and IPP players like BATR and POWR.
US utility resilience (EIX, AWK, PCG) reflects rate-base growth from grid modernization and water infrastructure, a multi-year capex cycle independent of macro swings.
Climate-tech divergence favors emerging-market operators over US pure-plays, as Indonesia's lower labor costs and resource abundance underpin higher margins in solar and battery storage.
sectors.ai: Buy the dip on Indonesia-exposed renewables names like BATR and POWR, which are outperforming despite a flat sector; US utilities (EIX, AWK, PCG) offer defensive yield but limited upside. Rotate into domestic climate-tech plays tied to Indonesia's energy transition, as policy tailwinds and tariff-free US exposure support relative strength.

US-linked infrastructure plays face headwinds from higher-for-longer rates, making local-currency, government-backed projects the preferred risk-adjusted exposure.

Rotate out of US-exposed names like PACK and ASLI, which lag on Fed uncertainty. Favor LINK for digital infrastructure upside, and accumulate EXCL on telecom tower re-rating.

sectors.name: Logistics
themes: Indonesia's inter-island trade and commodity logistics demand remain structurally insulated from US slowdowns, supporting sustained domestic volume growth for port and shipping operators.
Consolidation in port and warehouse assets, plus tariff adjustments, is driving margin expansion for mid-cap logistics names like KJEN and SOCI, a durable earnings driver.
Government infrastructure spending on ports and toll roads continues to lower distribution costs, structurally improving profitability for integrated logistics players over multi-year horizons.
sectors.ai: Buy logistics selectively on domestic volume recovery, not broad beta: KJEN, PORT, and SOCI lead on port/warehouse throughput and tariff repricing, while TMAS and RMKE offer coastal bulk upside. Trim US-exposed names if global trade slows; hold core positions through Q3 as IDX logistics outperformance persists on resilient inter-island demand.
